title: Start here
intro: DiscoCan admin helps you follow trucks, review trips and faults, and manage your fleet and devices. The Storybook tree follows the admin menu in the same order; pages opened from a menu item sit underneath it.
review: Choose English or Bulgarian with Language in the Storybook toolbar. Theme and the phone viewport let you review the same screen in a different appearance or width. Open a state, then use its controls to explore.
sourcesNote: Storybook uses fixed examples and does not contact live services or send commands to trucks. Fleet records and preferences are stored in DiscoCan.

entries.overview: See the fleet totals and recent activity from demo telemetry.
entries.alerts: Review and acknowledge alerts generated from demo telemetry.
entries.trips: Browse trips and open their details using demo telemetry.
entries.vehicles: Manage the selected fleet’s vehicle records, profiles and odometer settings in DiscoCan.
entries.drivers: Manage driver records and assignments in DiscoCan; scorecards use demo telemetry.
entries.devices: Manage tracking-device records and vehicle assignments in DiscoCan.
entries.maintenance: Plan and record service work for the selected fleet in DiscoCan.
entries.vehicle-groups: Organize the selected fleet’s vehicles into groups stored in DiscoCan.
entries.general: Choose the fleet name, units and time zone, stored in DiscoCan.

report: Send the full story title from the sidebar, explain what looks wrong or what you expected, and attach a screenshot. Include the Language, Theme and viewport you used.
buildingBlocksNote: Design System contains the shared layout, colours, controls and panels used across the admin.
